_note: Open-source projects built for Twilio's ConversationRelay protocol, reviewed by reading each repository's source (at reviewedCommit) against VoiceML's <Connect><ConversationRelay> implementation. Not tested on live calls. Re-review when VoiceML's relay support or a listed project changes, and update `reviewed`.

unsupported: sendDigits and language-switch messages from your app (ignored)
caller details (from, to, direction, callerName) in the setup message
other <ConversationRelay> attributes, such as dtmfDetection and interruptByDtmf (ignored; DTMF is always forwarded)

projects.notes: Its DTMF attributes are ignored (VoiceML always forwards DTMF), and the <Parameter> values it adds are not forwarded; the sample does not read them.
Memory across calls from the same number does not carry over: it keys memory on a caller number passed as a <Parameter>, which VoiceML does not forward, so each call starts fresh.
Sending DTMF and switching language mid-call are ignored, and its custom parameters are not forwarded.
Needs a one-line change: it reads the caller number from the setup message, which VoiceML does not send. Change message['from'] to message.get('from', '') or the call ends after setup.
Implements the full protocol; its sendDigits and language helpers have no effect on VoiceML.
Built on conversationrelay-bridge-js; uses the core prompt-and-reply loop.
